## What and why

Closes #<issue number>. (Open an issue first for anything beyond a typo.)

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated; `pytest tests/ -m "not gpu"` and `pytest scripts/tests/ -m "not gpu"` pass
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes (ruff, SPDX header check)
- [ ] New `.py` files start with the SPDX header
- [ ] Docs updated
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry under the unreleased version
- [ ] I agree that my contribution is licensed as described in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] New example? The [PR checklist](../doc/tutorials/NewExample/PR_Checklist.md) is filled in
